blocks.text: DNA har jaandaar cell ke nucleus mein hai. Yeh proteins banane ka code shuda mansooba, ya naqsha, hai jo zindagi ke liye zaroori hain; har khaas protein aik khaas gene, DNA ke aik hisse, se banta hai. DNA tamam jaandaron ki nashonuma, kaam, barhne aur tolid ki jeneyati hidayaat rakhta hai. Is ka double helix apne chaar bases ki tarteeb mein maloomat jama karta aur protein ki tayyari ke liye mo'assar aur durust taur par aage deta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: paanch dabbe, genome (tamam DNA, nucleus mein), chromosome (insani cell mein 23 jore), gene (aik protein ke liye DNA ka hissa), DNA (shakar-phosphate zanjeer par bases) aur codon (teen bases aik amino acid ka code). Neeche: replication se DNA -> DNA (DNA polymerase), transcription se DNA -> mRNA (RNA polymerase) nucleus mein, aur translation se mRNA -> protein (ribosome aur tRNA) cytoplasm mein.
blocks.caption: Genome se codon tak, aur jeneyati maloomat ka bahao (Figures 27.14 aur 27.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Maloomat DNA mein bases ki tarteeb mein jama hai, chromosomes par genes ki shakal mein. Protein banane ke liye gene mRNA mein transcribe hota, jo nucleus chhorta hai; ribosome par teen bases ka har codon aik khaas amino acid lane wale tRNA se milta hai, is liye bases ki tarteeb amino acids ki tarteeb ban jati hai.

blocks.text: Genes bari units, chromosomes, mein munazzam hain; insaan walidain se 23 jore paate hain. Taqreeban har cell mein 23 joron ka poora set hota hai, lekin har qism ka cell apne kuch hi genes use karta hai: jo cell khoon ka surkh cell banega woh haemoglobin ka gene chalu aur keratin ka gene band rakhta hai.

1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne dikhaya ke DNA do polynucleotide zanjeeron par mushtamil hai. Har zanjeer daen haath ka helix banati aur dono zanjeerein aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banati hain. Zanjeerein aik jaisi nahi balke takmeeli (complementary) hain, aur ulti simton mein chalti hain: aik ka 3' sira doosri ke 5' sire ke saamne hai. Har zanjeer ki shakar-phosphate reerh hai jis se bases seedhe zaviye par nikalte aur doosri zanjeer ke bases se kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure hain. Adenine (A) hamesha thymine (T) ke saamne aur guanine (G) cytosine (C) ke saamne hai; A-T jore mein do aur G-C jore mein teen hydrogen bonds hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: baari baari P (phosphate) dairon aur S (shakar) pentagons ki zanjeer, har shakar par aik base, 5' sire se 3' sire tak. Neeche: do khari reerhein jin ke teer ulti simton mein, aur un ke darmiyan bases ki patiyan: A-T aur T-A jore do dashed hydrogen bonds se, C-G aur G-C jore teen se.
blocks.caption: Polynucleotide zanjeer aur DNA ki base pairing (Figures 27.13 aur 27.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har dhaage ki reerh shakar aur phosphates ki mazboot covalent zanjeer hai. Dono dhaage sirf jore wale bases ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se jure hain, A T ke saath aur G C ke saath, jo itne kamzor hain ke DNA ki naqal ke waqt alag ho sakein. Kyunke jore muqarrar hain, har dhaaga doosre ko dobara banane ki maloomat rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Genes DNA ke woh khaas hisse hain jo jeneyati maloomat rakhte aur cell ko khaas proteins banane ki hidayat dete hain. DNA ka ahem amal apni naqal (self-replication) hai: cell cycle ke dauran DNA copy hota hai, taa ke cell ki taqseem par har naye cell ko jeneyati maadde ka poora set mile. Is tarah jeneyati maloomat aik cell se us ke beti cells aur agli nasal tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt: A-T jore aur G-C jore ko kitne hydrogen bonds jorte hain?
blocks.explanation: A aur T ke darmiyan do; G aur C ke darmiyan teen.

items: DNA: daen haath ke double helix mein do ulti simt ki polynucleotide zanjeerein (Watson aur Crick, 1953).
A-T (2 hydrogen bonds), G-C (3 hydrogen bonds).
Genes proteins ka code; cell taqseem se pehle DNA ki naqal.
